name: Stone Plastics & Manufacturing
old_description: Stone Plastics is a privately held, state of the art, injection molding and manufacturing company boasting a 165,000 square foot facility. We are IATF 16949:2016 certified with capability ranging from custom injection molding, 2-shot molding, inserting molding, pad printing, sonic welding and assembly services. We are uniquely vertically integrated with all services to handle our customer’s need for part feasibility, tool design/build management, equipment and automation design build, and in-house measurement of the finished part. We pride ourselves in quality every step of the way. We would love to partner with you, as together, we mold a better future.
about:
Stone Plastics & Manufacturing operates a 165,000-square-foot facility in Zeeland, Michigan. The privately held company does not disclose its founding year or founders publicly. The company traces its roots to scientific molding.

The company provides custom injection molding, 2-shot molding (rotational and robot transfer), and insert molding on horizontal and vertical presses ranging from 5 to 500 tons. Secondary operations include pad printing, sonic welding, and assembly. Stone Plastics also manages tool design and build, equipment and automation design and build, and in-house measurement and inspection. Engineering and program management teams support design feasibility through PPAP launch. The facility employs approximately 200 people.

Stone Plastics serves the automotive industry, evidenced by its IATF 16949:2016 certification. The company works with customers from concept through production, offering design feasibility and program management.

The company emphasizes vertical integration and scientific molding principles as differentiators, stating it handles part feasibility, tooling, automation, and measurement in-house. It also highlights an out-of-the-box approach to solving customer problems.
